verdict.rationale: Devin's self-serve billing docs describe individual subscription plans (Pro and Max) whose usage quotas cover use of the agent, so subscription-based access is implied. No evidence shows how a developer signs in with that plan in the CLI, Desktop, or cloud agent. Missing for 10: documented sign-in/authentication flow tied to the subscription plan, explicit confirmation that plan quota applies across the CLI/Desktop agent surfaces, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: Max is for individual users who consistently exceed the Pro quota. It includes everything in Pro, plus a significantly larger weekly usage quota (with no daily cap)
Power users who need more quota
